Mia and her grandfather watch helplessly as dark clouds portend the coming of an invasion force, but five warriors and a white tiger arrive to defend against the threat, despite their inability to work as a team.
Talpa dispatches his warlord Anubis to find Mia as a way of drawing out the warriors; the team attempts to defend Mia but find Anubis a force to be reckoned with.
With the warriors scattered across the world, Mia and Ully go in search of Ryo, with the evil forces in hot pursuit; Ryo battles Anubis on a volcano.
Ryo, Mia and Ully seek help from Mia's grandfather to find the other warriors, but he suspiciously refuses to help them; Anubis rounds up the city's populace and orders Sekhmet to attack the heroes.
Mia uses a line from her grandfather's poem to find where Sage is imprisoned, but Sekhmet tracks them down before they can get to Sage, forcing Ryo into battle once again.
The gang heads to the Sea of Toyama to find Cye, where Ryo must brave a whirlpool and Sekhmet to rescue him, but forces weaken Ryo's armor to the point where victory may be out of reach.

Dyce leaves Conan trapped in an Industria holding cell and escapes with Lana to the Barracuda; he finds cover in a dense fog but Lepka is close behind.
With Lepka's gunboat in pursuit, Lana uses a lifeboat to rescue Conan from the open sea.
As they navigate a vast desert, Conan and Lana are discovered by a salvage ship captain named Patch.
Earthquakes rattle Industria as Lepka continues his search for Lana's grandfather Dr. Lao.
Conan, Lana, and Dr. Lao take to the skies in Dr. Lao's flying machine.
Trapped by Lepka, Lana and Dr. Lao must navigate Industria's Core Block in search of machine parts.

The gang takes a trip to the mountains to stay at a resort run by Satsuki's cousin Miyuki; upon arrival, a young girl tells them that Miyuki is dead; it seems that her ghost still haunts the frozen lake, turning it blood-red.

Satsuki is asked to perform the after-school broadcast when the previous announcers fall ill; it seems the ghost of a deceased broadcast club member has invaded the system, intent on killing anyone that might upstage her.

A headless rider terrorizes the town on the anniversary of what was his death, seeking to decapitate people like himself; when the ghost turns his headlights upon Satsuki, the gang needs to find a way to put him to sleep again, and quickly.
Ouma intends to kill Kayako's children, Satsuki and Keiichirou; the battle against Ouma will require help.
Joe alights the Radorio mother ship to buy enough time for it to get away from Grathan.
Joe expects help from the Earth Federation Forces to get himself and the others out of Phobos.
Hazzard's shrewd move makes it difficult for the Radorio mother ship to find a way out of Phobos.
Princess Romina's growing fondness for Joe does not sit well with Gameran and Icelander.

Mr. Goblin just wants some peace and quiet (and maybe some company every once in a while). It's too bad he always seems to be in the wrong place at the wrong time. Lum and her friends find him, and he seems to overstay his welcome.

Rei crashes study hall at Tomoboki High. In order to appease his voracious appetite, everybody's lunch is offered to him. As one could imagine, it is never enough. After all, this is Rei we're talking about.
Ippo fights Yusuke.
After a fight, Ippo makes a new friend.
Ippo and his opponent Jason prepare for the first match of the Rookie King Tournament.
Ippo vs. Jason.
A school field trip to a seismology department is interrupted by a robot constantly lying about an impending earthquake.
Scientists use robotic creations for competition; two robots from competing camps fall in love.
Led by a clue given by a robot Dr. Elephant assembled, Astro Boy heads to Antarctica with Daddy Walrus to investigate the gang of Black Looks and beat them off.
Cleopatra is resurrected before her Egyptian public, but a robot Caesar steals the sign of the queen and passes it off to Astro.
Astro rescues Goliath, a mining robot from Mars, from a burning wreck.
Atlas gets falsely accused of destroying space stations; Livian begs Astro not to fight Atlas.
Ikki enters Metabee in the city's Robattle tournament.
Koji and Sumilidon defeat Metabee but think Ikki threw the match.
A tabloid reporter suspects Ikki is the Phantom Renegade.
Rubberobo gang-members want to become rock 'n' roll outlaws and run over a woman's shopping bags of anti-aging wrinkle cream.
